its $250,000 budget.","source_id":"47baeaf8-7366-4375-8838-25638b558ea2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"Most of it was marble.","source_id":"47baeaf8-7366-4375-8838-25638b558ea2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"The north face and basement, though, got cheaper brownstone, because the planners bet hardly anyone would bother looking at the building from behind.","source_id":"47baeaf8-7366-4375-8838-25638b558ea2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"Then, between 1954 and 1956, crews stripped the top four inches off the entire facade, recut it in Alabama veined limestone, redid the basement in red granite, and re-carved every column, capital, balustrade, and length of trim.","source_id":"47baeaf8-7366-4375-8838-25638b558ea2","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":6},{"text":"So the graceful building in front of you is, stone for stone, a replica of the
